description: A script that wraps the execution of lintrunner in an isolated virtual environment, managing setup, plugin initialization, and execution of lintrunner with command-line arguments.

methods.name: find_repo_root
methods.description: Finds the root directory of the git repository using 'git rev-parse'.

methods.name: compute_file_hash
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 hash of a file's contents.

methods.name: read_stored_hash
methods.description: Reads a stored hash value from a file, returns None if not available.

methods.name: get_hook_venv_path
methods.description: Constructs the path to the hook virtual environment based on repository root.

methods.name: find_hook_venv
methods.description: Locates the hook virtual environment directory, exits if not found.

methods.name: check_lintrunner_installed
methods.description: Checks if lintrunner is installed in the virtual environment.

methods.name: run_lintrunner
methods.description: Executes lintrunner within the specified virtual environment with given arguments.

methods.name: initialize_lintrunner_if_needed
methods.description: Initializes lintrunner plugins if the configuration has changed.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point to run lintrunner in the isolated environment, managing setup and execution flow.
